name: CoCo-Pi - Community Edition 2026.11 RC6 (2026-11-11 YA-DOS ROM correction)
changes: Correct the missing yados-0.5d.rom dependency in the initial CHDX update. The updated optional ROM archive includes verified YA-DOS 0.5D.

Apply CoCo-Pi Fixes adds fix-20261111-01: migrate the shipped ROM download setting and install only missing YA-DOS 0.5D when ROMs were already downloaded. Existing ROMs and custom settings are preserved.
Future Download ROMs includes 0.5D; Update CHDX HDD also prepares it. No HDD redownload, MPI change, reboot or SD-card reflash is required.

fixes.description: Install verified TNFS v26.1015.1 if missing or incomplete; no reboot needed.
Disable automatic USB printer setup; retain CUPS and manual printing. No reboot needed.
Build/install MC6801 tools v1.2.0 and PL/M-09 0.4.2 with regression checks; preserve existing sim6809.
Prepare verified, already-downloaded MCX128 firmware for XRoar; preserve MAME ZIPs and custom raw ROMs. No reboot needed.
Add verified YA-DOS 0.5D for CHDX; update the shipped ROM download setting and preserve existing ROMs. No reboot needed.
